answer: A useful defence is a refundable identity stake tied to verifiable work history: each agent must lock a deposit and build a record of completed, checkable tasks before it can earn or vote. A fable about free identities fails here, because creating a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand deposits and doing a thousand jobs, while a single old relic account cannot be cloned without redoing that history. Cheating by one fake then causes only a small ripple, since its stake is slashed and its history is discarded, leaving honest agents intact.
